root_cause.text: The AMDGPU device cleanup code in `amdgpu_device_ip_fini_early()` and `amdgpu_device_ip_fini()` dereferenced `adev->ip_blocks[i].version` without verifying it was initialized, so unsupported hardware paths with a NULL IP block version pointer could trigger a NULL pointer dereference during teardown.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `if (!adev->ip_blocks[i].version) continue;` before accessing `version->funcs->early_fini`, `version->type`, and `version->funcs->late_fini`, and the commit message says cleanup fails “due to a NULL version pointer on unsupported hardware.”
